🏀 PMSoc × SUCE 3x3 Basketball Tournament 🏀

Think you’ve got what it takes? Bring your team, hit the court and battle it out in our 3x3 Basketball Tournament at Perry Park !!

📅 Monday, 12 Oct
📍 Perry Park, Alexandria
⏰ 10:30 AM - 2:30 PM
🏀 Games start at 11:00 AM
💰 $25 per team | $9 individual
🏆 Compete for over $750 worth of prizes !!

Teams will compete in a round-robin format before progressing to knockouts, with games running for 15 minutes or until a team reaches 21 points.

Sportsmanship: Any dissent or disrespect towards referees, staff or other competitors will result in disqualification.

Arrive by 10:45 AM for the briefing.

Limited spots available !! Get your team together and get ready to compete by registering via the link in bio 🏆
